propositions: Approved code cleanup remediations from principal-engineer audit must be delivered through non-overlapping child tickets organized by structural-headroom, behavioral-oracle, adapter, public-deprecation, internal-shim, and supplemental categories.
Internal-only compatibility shims must be migrated across all static, dynamic, string, test, and monkeypatch consumers before deletion, gated by a prerequisite ADR.
Reconciler compatibility removals require dependency-ordered migration of persisted state and live lock/exit contracts before old routes disappear.
Public API removals and deprecations must state their canonical replacements and breaking-change impact before removal.

All eight environment/config aliases, scheduled CLI aliases, reconcile family commands, Python/MCP operation aliases, and private MCP model re-exports must be deprecated and removed with documented canonical replacements.
